verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are plain async TypeScript functions with no workflow DSL (trigger-dev-docs-34), and `triggerAndWait()` returns result data that the next step can use (trigger-dev-docs-16). Data mapping and transformation between steps is therefore done by writing ordinary code, which a user who switched from n8n describes as working in the IDE (trigger-dev-comm-1). For an ops user this means developer effort rather than a built-in mapping tool. Missing for 10: any expression or formula language or visual data-mapping UI, and docs specifically on transforming data between steps.
